itemOffered.name: Applied AI Engineering
itemOffered.description: GoGloby turns engineering into AI-native production. It puts Claude into production for established software, without risking the codebase. Forward-deployed AI Solutions Architects, safe by design.
itemOffered.serviceOutput: Claude running in production inside the established codebase, delivering shipped features under engineer oversight, without risking the platform, with board-ready proof that the AI budget is producing output.

itemOffered.name: Generative AI Development Services
itemOffered.description: Production-ready generative AI delivery covering GenAI integration, multi-agent orchestration, optimization and evaluation, and ongoing support and governance. GoGloby's Applied AI Software Engineers build copilots, AI agents, RAG applications, and agentic workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen. Forward-deployed into your team in under 4 weeks. Zero IP exposure. $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) from day one.
itemOffered.serviceOutput: Production-ready generative AI products including copilots, AI agents, RAG applications, and multi-agent systems shipped inside the client's AI development inside the client perimeter with sprint-by-sprint AI Intelligence Layer reporting.

audience.audienceType: VP of Engineering, SVP Engineering, CTO at US-based Established software companies (100 to 3,000 employees)

itemOffered.name: AI Staff Augmentation
itemOffered.description: Embed the top 4 percent of Applied AI Software Engineers directly into your team, your sprints, your tools, and your codebase. Every engineer is vetted through a 4-stage technical funnel covering Specify, Navigate, Architect, and Govern. Vetted profiles delivered in 72 hours. First validated feature in 3 to 5 business days. 120-day telemetry-backed replacement guarantee. $3M combined liability (cyber, data and professional) included.
itemOffered.serviceOutput: Vetted Applied AI Software Engineers forward-deployed in under 4 weeks, with the first validated feature in 3 to 5 business days and median time to first production commit of 23 days.

audience.audienceType: VP of Engineering, SVP Engineering, CTO at US-based Established software companies (100 to 3,000 employees)

itemOffered.name: Hire Applied AI Engineers
itemOffered.description: Direct hire recruitment for senior Applied AI Engineers brought directly into your headcount. Every candidate runs GoGloby's 4-stage vetting funnel (Specify, Navigate, Architect, Govern) with only 4 percent passing. Shortlist delivered in 5 days. 50 percent faster time-to-hire than US job boards. 120-day replacement guarantee. No fee until you hire. Talent network spans 5 plus US-timezone countries.
itemOffered.serviceOutput: Shortlist of production-proven Applied AI Engineers delivered in 5 business days, with 1 in 3 candidates hired and retained.
